learning.strategy: With no Beta-owned routing items, used spare capacity on highest-priority active Alpha risk-source assist. Changed source class from prior operating/technical evidence to SEC business-combination capital-structure disclosure to avoid duplicate no-change work.

learning.next: Do not retry this request at the same input signature; allow reconcile/Alpha to consume the new evidence and change the assist signature before further Beta work.
